blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of front, arm-cross, crouch and sit renders: the shorts hem is visible in neutral but both gray thighs break through the white shorts coverage up to the hips in crouch and sit. A narrow white strip remains between the thighs in neutral. The intended under-short layer does not retain hip-flexion coverage.

Direct inspection of back, three-quarter, crouch, sit and prone renders: the rear overskirt still forms two long, sharply pointed strips beneath the seat in crouch and sit. The panels collapse into angular tails instead of controlled pleats; the shorter/narrower V9 trial did not resolve this defect.

Direct inspection of front, side, neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders: broad faceted wrinkles and pinched folds persist around sleeves, underarms and jacket waist. The surface does not read as a finished smooth fencing jacket.

The diagonal lilac placket and button-like details are visible, but the prototype construction declares the closure unfastened and no retained fastening is demonstrated. Do not infer closure security or fit from the render.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
